Passthrough errors: 401/-20651/-20652/-20675 -> one silent refresh_session (deduplicated across threads) then 'session expired; sign in again'; -20571 -> TapoConnectionError 'Camera is offline'; -20002/408 -> 'Camera did not respond'; 429 -> 'busy'; other cloud codes -> TapoDeviceError; non-zero responseData.error_code -> TapoDeviceError(code,'multipleRequest'); missing outputParams/responses -> TapoProtocolError. The cloud lock is not held during the HTTP call (cameras in parallel); default timeout 30 s (app value).

Routing: cloud_routed(cfg) = source cloud and (role != 0 or not on the LAN). Shared cameras never get a LAN control client / :8800 / RTSP, even when found by TDP; without a signed-in provider they report SHARED_CLOUD_ONLY. Owned LAN cameras unchanged (auth breaker local only). Providers whose cloud client lacks iot_request/things keep the Phase 3 NETWORK_ONLY refusal.
Remote get_status = one batched services-sync call (4 getters).
Motion polling for cloud-routed cameras: getLastAlarmInfo through the cloud at most every 30 s (REMOTE_ALARM_POLL_INTERVAL_S), never ONVIF; LAN polling unchanged (5 s).

Remote download: streamType 3 + subType cover + LAN 'get download' first; if slot / tunnel / first answer fails (non-fatal), fall back to the verified streamType 1 playback ('get playback' client_id 1, channels [0], scale 1/1, event_type [1,2]) recorded until finished, PTS reaching the clip end (then 'do stop null') or tunnel close; fatal relay refusals (offline, not bound, stream limit) are raised without fallback; same remux/progress/cancel/cleanup as RecordingDownloader.
Missing thing record -> one thing-list refresh (local_access_tokens, at most every 60 s), else NETWORK_ONLY.
